purpose: Observe an ordinary customer's ChatGPT conversation, elapsed time and exposed usage/cost evidence, separately from the proprietary SuiroAI agent.
starting_question: What should I restock in my stores next week? I usually look at the last few months of sales to decide what to buy.
input_scope: Original authorized four CSVs from /private/tmp/dsc59-four-inputs, unchanged; no SuiroAI prompt, generated routine, prior answer, comparison scores or transformed sales partition supplied.
surface: Ordinary ChatGPT Chat mode in a new temporary conversation. UI notice states memory and custom instructions are not followed. Existing displayed Medium thinking setting is unchanged; underlying model identity is not presumed.
customer_role: Nontechnical retail owner. Give brief everyday answers grounded in supplied facts. Do not choose metrics/models/cleaning policies or inject the agent's analytical workflow. If missing business facts are requested, acknowledge unavailable information rather than invent facts. Clarify the supplied November 30 planning snapshot and December 1-7 week if asked.
followups: Respond naturally to questions; request a usable item/store/quantity list or file if needed. Do not force extra rounds to inflate elapsed time or tokens.
completion: A usable restocking list and understandable explanation, or an explicit unresolved blocker; record deficiencies separately without changing the benchmark's customer role.
timing: Timestamp upload interaction, initial send, each observed assistant completion and each customer follow-up send, and final usable-answer observation. Report wall time and observable waiting/interaction intervals separately. Automation, polling and observer overhead are included in wall time; this is not measured average human labor.
trace: Retain visible conversation text, screenshots and UI action timestamps. Do not fetch private application state or hidden network endpoints. Hidden provider/system/tool context and reasoning are unobserved unless explicitly exposed by supported UI.
cost: Calculate from actual exposed usage if available and verified applicable pricing. If exact usage/model/billing is unavailable, do not invent full-run tokens or an actual charge. Distinguish any declared visible-transcript/API-equivalent estimate from total backend cost and ChatGPT subscription charges.
interpretation: One observed customer-role conversation, not a controlled universal speed/cost/forecasting comparison or an untouched evaluation. Earlier demo video will be redone later per user instruction.
